items.t: ABS module can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Turbo oil feed line can leak and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Headlights flicker or shut off in Auto mode (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Harsh upshifts from worn transmission solenoids
items.job: Replace two shift solenoids, relearn and update transmission software
items.note: Ask a dealer if any goodwill or warranty coverage applies.

items.t: Rough downshift from 3rd to 2nd gear
items.job: Transmission computer software update (SA174)
items.note: Service action; normally done free by a Kia dealer.

items.t: A/C stops cooling from a seized compressor
items.job: Replace A/C compressor and receiver-drier, evacuate and recharge
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $1,430-$1,610 for 2015-2017 and $2,230-$2,530 for 2019-2020.

items.t: Hard to start or shut off from a broken start button
items.job: Inspect and replace start/stop button switch (SA228)
items.note: Service action; free if still open on your VIN.

items.t: Unsteady engine speed on early V8 cars
items.job: Engine computer software update (SA165)
items.note: Service action; normally free at a Kia dealer.

items.t: Weak low-beam headlights
items.job: Check and re-aim headlights; inspect auto-leveling

items.t: Car pulls to one side
items.job: Four-wheel alignment
items.note: If a tire is the cause, a new tire costs extra.

items.t: Fog or moisture inside the headlights
items.job: Inspect headlight vents and seals; replace headlight only if water pools

items.t: Oily film on the brake calipers
items.job: Inspect brake calipers and clean assembly oil

items.t: Collision warning or smart cruise warning light
items.job: Inspect radar sensor mounting and calibrate radar

items.t: Front headrest hard to adjust
items.job: Replace front headrest elevator module (SA177)
items.note: Service action; free if still open.

items.t: Navigation error message from the wrong SD card
items.job: Exchange navigation map SD card

items.t: UVO connected services not working
items.job: Check UVO activation and update head unit software

items.t: UVO services dead until the head unit is reset
items.job: Head unit factory reset (SA376)

items.t: Transmission cooler line connection can come loose
items.job: Inspect and reseat transmission cooler hose connections (SA368); top off fluid
items.note: Service action; free if still open.

items.t: Squeak from the turbo wastegate when accelerating
items.job: Inspect and lubricate turbo wastegate linkage

items.t: Battery drains when devices are left plugged in
items.job: Battery test and parasitic drain test
items.note: If the battery is ruined, RepairPal puts a K900 battery replacement at about $400-$455.

items.t: Sunglass holder door won't latch
items.job: Repair overhead console sunglass door latch

items.t: Radio presets erased after a reboot
items.job: Head unit software update (SA443)

items.t: Radio won't respond to the button or screen
items.job: Head unit software update
